classification.difficultyReason: One right-triangle tan⁻¹, then recognise that θ is the exterior angle and subtract from 180°.

content.prompt: Calculate the value of $\theta$ in this diagram. Answer to 1 d.p.

answer.worked:
Let $\alpha$ be the interior angle at the base of the slope. Opposite $=5$, adjacent $=7$.
$$\begin{align*}\tan\alpha&=\frac{O}{A}\\\tan\alpha&=\frac{5}{7}\\\alpha&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{5}{7}\right)\\\theta&=180^{\circ}-\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{5}{7}\right)\\\theta&\approx144.5^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^{\circ}$.
